Application Developer

Employment Type
Permanent Full Time
Department
IT Services — Academic Management Systems

About the Role

The Application Developer analyzes, designs, modifies, installs and maintains application programs to meet user needs at department, faculty and institutional level.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computing Science or related discipline, with five years of related experience.

  • Excellent knowledge of REST, JSON, SOAP and OAuth.
  • Excellent knowledge of MySQL, DB2, and SQL Server.
  • Good knowledge of agile, SCRUM, DevOps practices.

What We Offer

Hybrid-work program for eligible positions. Employer paid pension.
